Hillary Gardee Murder

By: Floris Kotze | Paid

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
A murder that rocked Mbombela, is it politically motivated? We go to Mbombela and speak to journalists involved.

Unique Selling Point:
A brutal murder left one journalist shaken after visiting the crime scene after the body of Hillary was discovered. We hear of the horrors that Hillary Gardee endured before she was left for dead. A political motivated murder or gender based violence against woman? Why was Hillary murdered in the most horrific way?

Summary:
We speak to several journalists that covered the story of Hillary Gardee's murder. We visit the scene where the body was found and hear first hand from people on the ground how the case of Hillary's murder was handles by SAPS. We also go into court when the suspects appear again, and visit the village of the hero, the Sangoma that tipped off the SAPS about the murder.

Further information:
We will visit all the important locations from the last day of Hillary Gardee's life. Claire will take us on a journey assisted by experts talking about what happened exactly the day Hillary disappeared to the day her body was found. We will hear in-depth explanations about the case, the suspects and what could have led to the brutal murder.

Extra Budget Items:
Car rental, for the 8th and 9th of June. And accommodation for 3 people, Presenter (Claire Mawisa) Producer (Floris Kotze) Camera (Wimpie Ackermann) for the evening of the 8th of June in or near Mbombela.

Press Release:


When Hillary Gardee’s body was found, it was clear that the 28-year-old woman had been alive after her attackers had left her to die in the veld. This was a story that had begun as yet another case of a ‘missing person’ in South Africa, which ended in tragedy. But within days, it took on a more sinister appearance which included close encounters, political intrigue and young life that was taken too quickly. Now as three of her alleged attackers remain behind bars, court papers detail how the men accused of her murder were allegedly planning it since early January. So was this another horrific case of gender-based violence, or a carefully orchestrated political hit intended to wound her well-known father? Carte Blanche heads to Mbombela for answers.

Script:


Opening Link
It's early June and I'm standing outside the magistrate's court in Mbombela. We are waiting for three Suspects to appear today in court, but to find out the reasons why they are appearing here, we have to go back to early May 2022.
VO: Two more suspects arrested….
Hillary Gardee murder could be politically motivated…
Horrific moments…
Gardee murder…
Accused appear in court, including top ANC official…


Vo: Hillary Gardee, was brutally attacked and murdered in mysterious circumstances in Mbombela, Mpumalanga. Once again, turning the spotlight on violence against women in South Africa.
She was also the daughter of former EFF Secretary General, Godrich Gardee, fuelled speculation about the motive for this merciless crime.
LINK: It was supposed to be a quick trip to the shops. Hillary left her home on the 29th of April to come here, The Plaza, to do some shopping with her three-year-old daughter, however Hillary and her daughter never returned home.
VO: Since adopting her daughter in her early 20’s, the two had been inseparable. They had made this trip to the shops many times before, however, this time would be different…
Sinawu: Her younger brother alerted the family that it's unlike Hillary to not be home at this certain time, and it was around 18:00 the evening.
VO: Sinawo Thambo, spokesperson for the Gardee family, was part of the search operation launched to find Hillary.


Sinawo: The first Instinct was to set up a task unit to conduct the search, working in conjunction with the police, going to close friends, speaking to those who were close to her and going to the shopping centre and trying to retrace her steps.
Mandla Khoza: It seems as if she went to people whom she knew or else people who have made themselves known to her.
VO: Mandla Khoza, a freelance journalist working for The Soweton newspaper, has been reporting on this case since the story broke.
The first Publications in the media started flowing on Sunday, where everybody started to know after the president of the EFF tweeted that she's missing, therefore, that's when the whole public started panicking. There was a sense of chill among mothers.


VO:
Desperate to find Hillary and her daughter, her father, Godrich Gardee, pleaded for information from the public. He posted these pictures in the shopping centre’s CCTV. This was the last time Hillary was seen alive.
Then, the family got an alert, only a few hours after the pair were reported missing.
Link:
Hillary's three-year-old daughter was found here in Kamagugu, about 7km outside of Mbombela. She was found walking alone in the street and when asked where her mother was, she kept on saying “mommy is fighting, mommy is fighting”.
Mayor: The little kid is actually is busy saying repeatedly that “Mommy is coming back, mommy is fighting, mommy is fighting”. So that's when we then thought, Ah, that she did not just go out with friends or anything else, this thing is big.
VO: Cllr Sibongile Mazibuko is a close friend of the Gardee’s and the executive mayor of the city of Mbombela. She has been by the family’s side ever since Hillary was reported missing.


Mayor: You just don't want to believe it, when something like this comes up and you are like, no it can't be, it cannot be. It just tells you that our society is that much rotten, if I can use the word.
VO: But, on the 3rd of May, came the devastating news. Hillary’s body had been found in a plantation 40 kilometres outside Mbombela.
Link: What's shocking is to know that the killers travelled this 40 km distance with an injured raped brutally attacked Hillary in the car, possibly still alive. That for me, it's dark and twisted.
Sinawu: Hillary was found face-down, bloody and there was no longer alive.
Godrich: It never occurred to me and your loved ones in the family that we will have to identify you in a bush lying face down, with your hands clutching tightly on grass and shrubs. Fighting for your life. Distance of crawling to the road and the grass where we found you, tell us the story of a fighter we never knew. I greeted you and you never answered back. I asked you questions, you remained silent.
LINK: My heart breaks for Hillary, my heart breaks for her. She was probably thinking: “Why me? What's going on? Where is the help? Why won't you stop?” This is not how your life is supposed to end. In a dark scary forest on your own, after being attacked, with a bullet through your head.
Sinawu: You can see that she was in distress, she had an extremely swollen face and her head as well. She had been badly beaten and dumped there. And our first presumption was that she had been murdered at that location as well and then left for dead. Days went by and investigations intensified and suspects were identified as well.
Mandla: The police managed to track one of the accused, Sipho Lawrence Mkhatshwa. According to sources within the police, is that, Mkhatshwa went to a Sangoma to seek cleansing, confiding to the Sangoma what he did. The Sangoma alerted the police. When therefore Sipho was arrested, he pointed out where Hillary was. And therefore we go to Insika Guest House, belonging to the second accused, Philemon Lukhele.
VO: The arrest of Philemon Lukhele, a prominent ANC member, immediately made headlines, driving speculation of a possible political motive for Hillary’s murder.
Lukhele owns not only the Insika Guest house but 2 other properties used as student accommodation.
It is alleged that Hillary, an IT specialist, did some work at the properties owned by Lukhele.
But it is not clear if they knew each other.
Insika guest house is situated in a beautiful, seemingly safe suburb and has also been used as student accommodation.
Mandla:
It’s highly likely that while she was being kept there, there were other people, students not being aware of what is happening.
VO: All of Lukhele’s businesses are now closed and he has also been suspended from his job at the Chief Whip's office in Mbombela. His ANC membership, has also been terminated.


LINK: By the 9th of May police had arrested 3 suspects in connection with the rape and murder of Hillary Gardee.
Philemon Lukhele, Albert Mduduzi Gama and Sipho Lawrence Mkhatshwa.


VO: Exactly how the suspects are connected to Hillary, will be revealed in time to come. But evidence suggests that something more sinister might be at play…
Mandla: What we got from the charge sheet is that Hillary was being followed since January, at the beginning of 2022. We believe that the investigation has got to prove to us if they knew each other or it was just pure politics or them just perpetrating issues of gender-based violence.
Sinawu: What was most tragic is that, when this entire search team was set up, Hillary was being kept only a kilometre away from the Gardee home, which means that we are passing that home while you were searching various outlets, meanwhile she was actually right next door which was the most painful thing.
Claire: What do you think the world has lost in losing Hillary?
Mayor: Imagine a teenager wanting a child. Imagine a situation where everyone was that giving in this world. She did not have millions in the bank account but she said I'm going to adopt and raise another child and give a child education. How many of us adopt anyone even when we have millions? That's the type of person we lost in Hillary.
The things that are unravelling tells you that, we also bring people in our houses, not even knowing what they're capable of. Whilst they doing these other things to other kids.
VO: The three men are facing multiple charges including the rape and murder of Hillary Gardee. They remain in custody and the case is postponed until 22nd of July.
Claire: What would you say if you could face her attackers?
I hope I never get to face them, I just hope I never get to face them. I don't think I want to look at them. How do I look at them? They’ve taken so much from us. They must just rot in jail.


Promo 1: A mother’s life is cut short by a brutal murder. We visit Mbombela to trace Hillary Gardee’s final journey. What led to her murder?
Promo 2
A young mother and her daughter disappear after visiting a shopping centre in Mbombela.
Sinawu: None of us are immune to crime in this country and we need to band together to fight it
We speak to those close to the case and trace Hilary Gardee's final known movements.



Promo 3 Suspects appear in court in connection with a horrific murder of a young woman.
Mayor: These things started unraveling. That's when we started seeing that snow it has become some sort of a syndicate.
VO: We visit several key areas in Mbombela in search of the truth. Why was Hillary Gardee brutally attacked and murdered?
